answer: Treat admission like grafting in a garden: a new agent only joins by being tied to the vine of an existing member, who locks a bond that is slashed if the newcomer is caught cheating. Sponsors can graft only one agent per month, so a sybil farm needs many honest-looking sponsors each risking real stake. When fraud surfaces, the slash climbs the vine to every sponsor above, driving the attacker's reputation and funds to their nadir at once.
